articles.title: Jets bench ineffective QB Fields, turn to Taylor
articles.summary: After a dismal first half Sunday, Justin Fields was replaced by backup Tyrod Taylor on the Jets' first offensive drive after halftime with the New York trailing the Panthers 13-3.

articles.title: Panthers QB Young leaves win with ankle injury
articles.summary: Panthers quarterback Bryce Young was ruled out for the rest of the game after suffering an ankle injury late in the third quarter of Sunday's game against the Jets.

articles.title: Coen: Blame for Jags' drubbing 'starts with me'
articles.summary: After watching a second consecutive game in which his team started slowly on offense, made numerous mistakes and committed double-digit penalties, Jaguars coach Liam Coen knew exactly who to blame: himself.

articles.title: Sources: Graham mulls unretiring to rejoin Philly
articles.summary: Former Eagles defensive end Brandon Graham is strongly considering coming out of retirement to sign with Philadelphia, sources told ESPN.

articles.title: Titans' Simmons injures hamstring, out vs. Pats
articles.summary: Titans defensive lineman Jeffery Simmons suffered a left hamstring injury in the second quarter of Sunday's game against the Patriots and was ruled out.

articles.title: Cards QB Murray (foot) inactive against Packers
articles.summary: Cardinals quarterback Kyler Murray is expected to return to play after Arizona's bye week for its Monday night game at the Cowboys on Nov. 3, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Raiders' Meyers sits, Crosby hurt in loss to K.C.
articles.summary: The Raiders, already without top pass catchers Jakobi Meyers (knee/toe) and Brock Bowers (knee), lose defensive end Maxx Crosby (knee/back) and defensive tackle Adam Butler (back) to injuries against the Chiefs.

articles.title: Colts lose concussed Ward for at least 4 games
articles.summary: The Colts have placed their top cornerback Charvarius Ward on injured reserve, sidelining him for Sunday's game against the Chargers and at least the next three contests.
